notes.title: 20250819 Update
notes.content:
[b][h3]Optimizations & Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a circular progress bar when holding down on enemies, making it easier to see how long it takes to open the Codex.
[*] Enhanced the 4th skills of Ranger and Bard.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the Mask of Agony could cause the game to crash under certain circumstances.
[*] Temporarily hid the Prince’s craftable equipment from the Workshop.
[/list]
